$schema: province weather states + seasonal calendar (master plan §33.1); consumed by the Phase 8 atmosphere/renderer stack and by hazard calendars (plan §26)
loreBasis: Tropical climate (Lore:Black Marsh); seasonal hatching/breeding hazards and travel-season advice (Tips for Black Marsh Travel); permanent gloom and torchbug nights in deep canopy (Tribes of Murkmire); fire risk in dry season (Blackwater War lore).

states.name: Ground mist
states.notes: Dawn/dusk default in marsh classes; mist field gives local density.

states.name: Monsoon downpour
states.notes: Raises flood state one band while active; rivers swell.

states.name: Dry-season haze
states.notes: Dry season only; peat-fire risk in burned/peat soils.

regionFrequencies.note: Relative weights per ecological region class; renderer/world-state sampler normalises.

seasons.name: Wet season
seasons.effects: flood states high, monsoon/storm weights x2, insect hatching peaks (travel-advice hazard calendar), boats favoured

seasons.name: Dry season
seasons.effects: flood states low, dry-haze enabled, some shallow crossings open, peat-fire risk, overland travel favoured

seasons.name: Hatching turn
seasons.effects: transition weeks: giant-snake and insect breeding hazards spike (Tips for Black Marsh Travel); guides advise against deep travel

lighting.dayNight: full cycle (Phase 8); canopy classes darken and diffuse daylight - jungle/rootland interiors read as permanent dusk
lighting.night: bioluminescence is the deep-marsh night palette: torchbugs, fungi, Hist sap glow
lighting.verticalExaggerationNote: visual-only; lighting/climate operate on true heights
